text:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC for the v2 API switch. Starting with EU canary at 5% for 20m, then 25% if healthy. Auto-rollback triggers: error rate >1.5% sustained 5m OR p95 latency >2.0s sustained 5m. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2-2026-04-02 :eyes:
elaine: I can own the canary watch. Who's running the client pinlist check for mobile SDK? Also confirm header negotiation will be tolerant for older clients.
matt: Mobile SDK team asked for a soft pin option — can we hold v1 clients on a TTL=24h pin if they signal old schema?
skre-jaime: (typo) meant to say @sre-jaime: I'll be on-call for the window. Runbook ready, alerting is hooked to the canary metric dashboards. If we hit rollback thresholds, operator should run the rollback command below.
---
```bash
# rollback to v1 global
redwoodctl rollout set --route api.v2 --target v1 --reason "auto-rollback"
```
---
kyle: We should also enable the fallback route for the EU edge region early (pre-canary) so traffic can be diverted if latency spikes. I've already staged the route config in staging.
ashley: Release notes blurb attached: "API v2: improved response multiplexing, header negotiation changes — backward-compatible when using X-Client-Schema=v1. See migration guide." I'll push the docs update now. :thumbsup:
tyler-prod: Confirming no breaking schema changes for typed responses; product approves soft pin behaviour for mobile with 24h TTL. We need a short note to partners about the small initial canary and how to opt-in.
elaine: I want the deploy-bot to annotate the canary with the operator tag so we can filter in traces. Also please add an ops-only slack hook for canary alerts to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: Noted. I'll attach tag "operator=elaine" to canary traffic and add the slack hook. Scheduling the canary now — will post another message at rollout start and when we promote.
sre-jaime: Quick checklist for responders: 1) Check canary-dashboard p50/p95/p99 and error-rate. 2) If thresholds breached, run rollback command and notify #incidents. 3) If minor increase (<=0.5% error uplift), hold and watch for 10m before acting.
matt: One more ask — can we put an A/B header gate so partners who opt-in get immediate v2 instead of waiting for global promotion? That avoids extra churn.
kyle: Yes, we have a flaggable header gate. I'll enable partner opt-in by 'X-Partner-Optin: v2' once canary is healthy.
elaine: I'm good to proceed. I'll watch the first 20m and call it if anything looks off. Thanks all. :tada:
